text: Call Anand Kamalnayan Pandit first. He is a promoter of Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited, and the filing shows ₹572.96 Cr cash in hand from an insider sale. It settled 5 Nov 2026, T+1 after the 4 Nov 2026 trade. Confidence is high, and the amount is not an estimate. This is the strongest call in today’s brief by the listed cash amount and timing.
